title: cast
description: N distinct, plausible background MetaHumans from one seed and a few ranges (WP3, B47). Each member is a character spec (asset <folder>/MH_<prefix><NN>), deterministic per seed; a larger count keeps the first members. Converged member by member through the character ops; in the editor by mh.variants make=true.

bySex.description: one value for all, or {female: ..., male: ...}

pool.description: names to pick from: one list, or per sex

seed.description: the seed: the same seed gives the same cast

folder.description: where the members' character assets go

presets.description: the preset faces to start from and blend (two per member, 50-90 % the first); per sex to keep faces and bodies matched

sex.description: any (half and half), female, male, or the share of women 0..1

age.description: years; mapped by rule of thumb onto grey hair/brows (from ~35), worn teeth and receding gums (from ~45), skin roughness

height_cm.description: cm: [low, high] for all, or {female: [..], male: [..]} (default 155-178 / 165-192)

eyes.description: iris colour palette ranges and patterns

hair.description: hair groom pool (one list in items, or per sex) and colour ranges

beard.description: men only: the chance of a beard and the pool; everyone else gets none

min_distance.description: how different two members must be (normalised traits); a closer candidate is redrawn

max_attempts.description: redraws per member before keeping the most different

rig.description: for every member: the cloud rig (none: shape only, no build)

build.description: build each member's Blueprint (BP_<name>), or false; an object passes build options (pipeline, quality)
